blocks.html: Private Deep Sea Fishing Charters in Los Cabos

Looking for private deep sea fishing charters in Los Cabos?

Exotic Fish Cabo offers personalized offshore sportfishing trips departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, Baja California Sur.

Our experienced bilingual captains help anglers explore offshore fishing grounds in search of marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado, wahoo, and other seasonal species.

Choose between 6-hour and 8-hour private fishing charters depending on your schedule, experience level, and fishing goals.

Whether you're planning your first deep sea fishing adventure or returning to Cabo for big-game fishing, our team can help you select the right trip.
Why Choose LOS CABOS for Deep Sea Fishing?

Los Cabos stands out as a premier destination for sport fishing enthusiasts for several compelling reasons:

  • Year-round fishing opportunities: The warm climate and diverse marine ecosystem mean excellent fishing conditions throughout the entire year

  • Abundance of trophy fish: Marlin, dorado (mahi-mahi), yellowfin tuna, wahoo, sailfish, and roosterfish are abundant in these waters

  • Proximity to fishing grounds: Fish the deep waters just hours from the marina—most offshore spots are only 15–50 miles away

  • Experienced local captains: Our crews have decades of combined experience and fish these waters 300+ days per year

  • Quick success potential: Land a monster fish in as little as 6–8 hours with our nearshore and offshore trips

Our Fishing Charter Options

Exotic Fish Cabo offers private 6-hour and 8-hour fishing charters departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

6-Hour Private Fishing Charters – From $350 USD per boat

An excellent option for couples, families, and anglers looking for a personalized fishing experience. Starting rates apply to selected charters for 1–2 guests. Depending on seasonal fish activity and ocean conditions, your captain may recommend coastal or offshore fishing opportunities.

8-Hour Private Deep Sea Fishing Charters – From $600 USD per boat

Our 8-hour trips provide additional time to explore offshore fishing grounds and target species such as marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado, and wahoo when conditions allow.

All charters are private, with pricing depending on the selected boat and group size. Trips normally depart at 6:30 AM from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

Fishing locations and travel distances depend on weather, sea conditions, and your captain's recommendations. Contact us to confirm availability and the best trip option for your group.

Peak Fishing Seasons in LOS CaboS

Winter months from January through March bring striped marlin, yellowfin tuna, and roosterfish with ideal weather and excellent conditions. This is one of the most popular seasons for visiting anglers.

Spring fishing from April through May features striped marlin, dorado, and yellowtail as water temperatures warm up and consistent action continues.

Summer months from June through August are hot for blue marlin, black marlin, wahoo, and roosterfish. Billfish enthusiasts flock to Cabo during these months for peak big game action.

Fall is peak season for big game fishing, running from September through November. This period brings yellowfin tuna, blue and black marlin, and sailfish. The legendary Bisbee's Black and Blue Tournament takes place during this time, attracting tournament anglers from around the world.

December offers multiple species including striped marlin, wahoo, dorado, and yellowfin tuna, making it an excellent month to plan your fishing adventure.

What's Included in Your Charter

Every private deep sea fishing charter with Exotic Fish Cabo includes an experienced local captain and crew, fishing rods, reels, and basic tackle.

Our team helps you select a suitable boat based on group size, fishing goals, and trip duration. Your captain adapts fishing techniques and locations to seasonal activity and ocean conditions.

Fishing licenses, live bait, food, drinks, transportation, and fish-cleaning services vary depending on the selected charter and must be confirmed before booking.

We'll explain your charter's inclusions and any additional costs before your fishing adventure.

Fish Species You Can Catch

Billfish represent the ultimate trophy in sport fishing. Striped marlin are available year-round with peak season from November through April. Blue marlin are most abundant during summer months from June through November. Black marlin appear during summer and fall (July–October), while sailfish are caught primarily during summer and fall months.

Premium game fish offer exciting action for all skill levels. Yellowfin tuna are available year-round with peak fishing from December through November. Dorado (mahi-mahi) are best caught spring through fall. Wahoo are available year-round with strong presence from June through December. Roosterfish are caught year-round with peak season from May through August.

Inshore species like snappers, groupers, and other bottom dwellers are excellent for families and beginners who want to experience the thrill of fishing in calmer, shallower waters.

Booking Your Deep Sea Fishing Charter

Booking your private deep sea fishing charter in Los Cabos is simple.

Start by choosing your preferred date and trip duration: 6 hours or 8 hours. Let us know your group size, fishing experience, and the species you'd like to target.

Our team will help you compare available charter options and confirm pricing, included services, and meeting instructions.

All Exotic Fish Cabo fishing trips depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, including bookings made by guests staying in Cabo San Lucas.

We recommend booking in advance to improve your chances of securing your preferred date and boat. Contact us to check current availability.

What to Bring and Know Before You Go

Sunscreen, a hat, and sunglasses are essential for protection from intense sun exposure. Wear lightweight, moisture-wicking clothing and bring non-slip footwear for safety on deck.

A valid Mexican fishing license is required for anglers. Please confirm how licenses will be arranged and whether they are included in your selected charter before departure.

If you're prone to seasickness, have medication on hand just in case. Remember that deep sea fishing requires stamina, so be prepared for an active day on the water. Good physical fitness will help you enjoy the experience to the fullest.

Why Our Charters Stand Out

At Exotic Fish Cabo, we focus on personalized private fishing experiences designed around your group, experience level, and fishing goals.

Our experienced local captains use their knowledge of Los Cabos waters to adapt fishing techniques and explore suitable fishing grounds according to seasonal activity and sea conditions.

We encourage responsible fishing practices, including catch-and-release when appropriate, and prioritize safety throughout every trip.

Whether you're visiting Los Cabos for the first time or returning for another offshore adventure, our team is here to help you plan a memorable fishing experience.

If weather conditions affect your scheduled departure, please contact us to discuss the available options under your booking terms.

Book Your los Cabos Deep Sea Fishing Charter Today

Don't miss your chance to fish the marlin capital of the world. Whether you're a seasoned angler seeking a trophy or a family looking for an unforgettable adventure, our deep sea fishing charters deliver world-class experiences in los Cabos.

Contact us now to check availability, compare boat options, and secure your spot for an incredible day on the water.
